newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Poyry ups long-term paper consumption forecast.
newsitem.headline: Poyry ups long-term paper consumption forecast.

text.p: Forestry consultancy group Jaakko Poyry has upwardly revised its forecast for the world's paper consumption, projecting by the year 2010 that annual paper consumption will reach 418 million tonnes.
This compared to an earlier forecast of 402 million tonnes. World paper consumption during 1995 was 289 million tonnes.
"The rise takes into account developments in China and to a certain extent India," Jan Rennel from Jaakko Poyry told a forestry industry seminar in Stockholm.
With the new forecast, Jaakko Poyry is estimating paper consumption to rise by 2.8 percent annually over the next 15 years.
